caption: Tell Monument, Altdorf
composition: Rathausplatz in Altdorf with the Tell Monument in front of the Türmli · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: On Rathausplatz in Altdorf, the Tell Monument stands on its stone pedestal in front of the medieval Türmli. The bronze shows a standing figure with a crossbow and a boy beside him, the historic 1895 monument rather than a crowd in the square. Old-town facades close the square, and no banner or readable inscription is added. The Open-Meteo model is fully overcast, with soft light and no rain.
